quotes.quote: You're not going to find me saying one thing publicly and another thing privately. Jensen is an old friend of mine. I would call Jensen Michael Jordan, perhaps at his peak level, in terms of what he means to a team.

You see him eating street food in Korea and Taiwan with critical suppliers. He has long-term relationships that have been built up over decades. He understands technology incredibly well. His team loves him. …
I think if we do this right, we can create an age of miracles where humanity is able to solve problems that have eluded us for millennia.
It was one of those crazy perfect storms where there was a latent bug that got sort of found only during a particular traffic pattern … Of course, we should have done the testing before. …

If you had told me 20 years ago that someone was going to make a movie about me, I think that would have struck me as … that would have been a very weird thing … Now it doesn’t feel like it’s in like the top 10 weirdest things about my life.

The fact that we are ushering in this technology that we have all of these very real concerns about, and that we have, we find ourselves in a role of such significance and such responsibility to make that go well … That’s a crazy situation to find yourself in.

As the models have gotten more capable, they can do more within just the forward path without having to actually write out that thinking, which means we need a new approach to monitoring … We’re going to need to deliver that, and I think that there will be points where we need …

I think it’s obviously a tough time for everyone, but again, I think Nvidia is such an incredible company … I think that… what Jensen has built there, it clearly is built to last, and so we’re excited to keep partnering and looking to the future.
